history_empty_hint: Words appear here after the first scheduled post or "Post now".

notify_load_failed: Failed to load Word of the Day data
notify_post_failed: Failed to post a word. Check the channel and filters.

posting_toggle_hint: Runs at the hour above in the selected timezone
reset_message: This removes the configuration, every custom word, all weekday and month rules, and the posting history for this server.
schedule_hint: Each rule only overrides what it sets and inherits the rest from the Settings tab. Weekday rules win over month rules.
source_hint: Topic and filters apply to dictionary words. Up to five topic words, e.g. "medieval history". Difficulty is based on how often a word appears in written English. Weekday and month rules on the Schedule tab override these.
template_fallback_warning: Your custom template rendered an empty message, so the default embed was posted instead.
template_hint: Leave empty to use the built-in embed with pronunciation, definition, and example.
template_placeholder: Click to build a custom message, or leave empty for the default embed
thread_name_hint: Leave empty to use the default, "{default}". Supports {wordToken}, {dateToken}, {posToken}, and server placeholders.
thread_toggle: Create a thread under each post
thread_toggle_hint: Invites people to use the word in a sentence
warning_no_channel: Posting is enabled but no channel is set, so nothing will be posted.
words_empty_hint: Add words above, then switch the source to "Custom" or "Mixed" on the Settings tab.
words_no_definition: No definition, one will be looked up when posted
